'''Hoge''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] officer in the [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Navy]]. By [[137 ABY]], Hoge held the rank of [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of the [[Relentless (Pellaeon-class)|''Relentless'']], flagship of the [[Outer Rim Third Fleet]]. The captain was present during the execution of [[Kel Dor/Legends|Kel Dor]] Admiral [[Sha Dun]] by [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Azard]]. Afterwards, Hoge was ordered by Admiral [[Dru Valan]], the new commander of the Third Fleet, to replace every single [[Alien/Legends|alien]] crew member and officer in the fleet with Humans.<ref name="Legacy 20" />

Hoge and Valan witnessed [[Jaius Yorub]] end the [[Battle of Mon Calamari (Second Imperial Civil War)|Battle of Mon Calamari]] by destroying much of the Empire's shipyards over [[Dac/Legends|Dac]]. Stunned, Valan turned the bridge over to Hoge. When the captain asked what to say to Darth Azard, Valan said it did not matter to him and to say whatever Hoge pleased; the admiral then went to his quarters to consider [[Death/Legends|suicide]].<ref name="Legacy 21">[[Legacy (2006) 21|''Legacy'' (2006) 21]]</ref>
